about: Part A: contract behaviour backed by a named Lean theorem (statement quoted from the source; statements over 20000 characters are cut, with the full length and location given). source_index is the 0-based index in the token status.json list (contract_findings, or findings_contract for link and wbtc); -1 = the headline theorem of a token with no such list (shib, qnt, bnb, weth). Part B: critical or major audit findings about the proofs that the fix records confirm, with the fix result. Dropped: source items, or parts of items, with no theorem that proves them.

part_a.finding: Starting from a state where the sum of all balances equals the total supply, this stays true after any finite list of whole transactions (from the Dencun fork, before Glamsterdam), whoever calls and however deep, under the named run-local hypotheses (Seq.TxClean per transaction).
part_a.statement:
theorem supply_any_transactions {C : Address} {b b' : BlockState}
    (chain : Seq.Chain C CODE SepMsg b b')
    (g : Seq.Good C CODE (Inv C) (TransactionState.ofBlock b)) :
    Seq.Good C CODE (Inv C) (TransactionState.ofBlock b')
part_a.note: headline theorem; this token has no contract_findings list

part_a.finding: After any finite list of whole transactions, totalSupply_ (slot 1) and the crowdsale address (slot 3) never change, and the sum of balances minus totalSupply_ never goes down, under the named run-local hypotheses.
part_a.statement:
theorem fixed_mono_any_transactions {C : Address} {b b' : BlockState}
    (chain : Seq.Chain C CODE SepMsg b b')
    (hold : Seq.HoldsCode C CODE (TransactionState.ofBlock b)) :
    Seq.HoldsCode C CODE (TransactionState.ofBlock b') ∧
      storageAt (TransactionState.ofBlock b') C 1 = storageAt (TransactionState.ofBlock b) C 1 ∧
      storageAt (TransactionState.ofBlock b') C 3 = storageAt (TransactionState.ofBlock b) C 3 ∧
      Supply.D 0 1 C (TransactionState.ofBlock b) ≤ Supply.D 0 1 C (TransactionState.ofBlock b')
part_a.note: headline theorem; this token has no contract_findings list

part_a.finding: The sum of all balances equals totalSupply_ after any finite list of whole transactions in which no message into QNT comes from the crowdsale address, under the named run-local hypotheses.
part_a.statement:

    Seq.Good C CODE (Inv C) (TransactionState.ofBlock b')
part_a.note: headline theorem; this token has no contract_findings list

part_a.finding: Any call that sends a nonzero value ends with an error: no run of the code from the start with message.value != 0 succeeds (per call).
part_a.statement:
theorem ok_valueSent (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hv : message.value ≠ 0)
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    False

part_a.finding: A call with less than 4 bytes of call data never succeeds (per call).
part_a.statement:
theorem ok_short (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize : message.data.size < 4)
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    False

part_a.finding: A successful transferFrom call has at least 100 bytes of call data and both address argument words have no bits set above the low 160 bits (per call); the same kind of requirement is in the other readable corollaries.
part_a.statement:
theorem transferFrom_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0x23b872dd)
    (hsep : Sep (callKeys message))
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (4 + 96 ≤ message.data.size) ∧
      (arg1 message = (addrArg1 message)) ∧
      (arg2 message = (addrArg2 message)) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ 0) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) ≠ 0) ∧
      ((sender message) ≠ 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (addrArg2 message) = 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (addrArg1 message) = 0) ∧
      (pairOf message state = 0 → ((addrArg1 message) = ownerOf message state ∨ (addrArg2 message) = ownerOf message state)) ∧
      (pairOf message state ≠ 0 → limitedOf message state ≠ 0 → pairOf message state = (addrArg1 message) → (balance message state (addrArg2 message)).toNat + (arg3 message).toNat ≤ (maxHolding message state).toNat ∧ (minHolding message state).toNat ≤ (balance message state (addrArg2 message)).toNat + (arg3 message).toNat) ∧
      ((arg3 message).toNat ≤ (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat) ∧
      ((arg3 message).toNat ≤ (allowance message state (addrArg1 message) (sender message)).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) ≠ (addrArg1 message) → (balance message state (addrArg2 message)).toNat + (arg3 message).toNat < 2 ^ 256)) ∧
    ((s.output = wordBytes 1) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) ≠ (addrArg1 message) → (balance message s.state (addrArg1 message)).toNat = (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat - (arg3 message).toNat ∧ (balance message s.state (addrArg2 message)).toNat = (balance message state (addrArg2 message)).toNat + (arg3 message).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) = (addrArg1 message) → balance message s.state (addrArg1 message) = balance message state (addrArg1 message)) ∧
      ((allowance message s.state (addrArg1 message) (sender message)).toNat = (allowance message state (addrArg1 message) (sender message)).toNat - (arg3 message).toNat) ∧
      (totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg1 message) 1 → k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg2 message) 1 → k ≠ mapSlot (sender message) (mapSlot (addrArg1 message) 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      (s.substate.logs = (substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget TRANSFER (addrArg1 message) (addrArg2 message) (wordBytes (arg3 message)))).push (log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL (addrArg1 message) (sender message) (wordBytes (sub (allowance message state (addrArg1 message) (sender message)) (arg3 message))))))

part_a.finding: A successful setRule call has at least 132 bytes of call data, its bool word is 0 or 1 and its pair address word is clean (no high bits set) (per call).
part_a.statement:
theorem setRule_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0x3aa633aa)
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (4 + 128 ≤ message.data.size) ∧
      ((arg1 message) = isZero (isZero (arg1 message))) ∧
      (arg2 message = (addrArg2 message)) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      (ownerOf message state = sender message)) ∧
    ((s.output = ByteArray.empty) ∧
      (storageAt s.state message.currentTarget 6 = bitwiseOr (isZero (isZero (arg1 message))) (bitwiseAnd (115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639680 : U256) (storageAt state message.currentTarget 6))) ∧
      (storageAt s.state message.currentTarget 9 = bitwiseOr (addrArg2 message) (bitwiseAnd (115792089237316195423570985007226406215939081747436879206741300988257197096960 : U256) (storageAt state message.currentTarget 9))) ∧
      (storageAt s.state message.currentTarget 7 = (arg3 message)) ∧
      (storageAt s.state message.currentTarget 8 = (arg4 message)) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ 6 → k ≠ 9 → k ≠ 7 → k ≠ 8 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      (s.substate.logs = substate.logs))

part_a.finding: A successful transfer requires that neither the caller (from) nor the receiver (to) is blacklisted (low byte of blacklists is 0) (per call).
part_a.statement:
theorem transfer_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0xa9059cbb)
    (hsep : Sep (callKeys message))
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (4 + 64 ≤ message.data.size) ∧
      (arg1 message = (addrArg1 message)) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      ((sender message) ≠ 0) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (addrArg1 message) = 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (sender message) = 0) ∧
      (pairOf message state = 0 → ((sender message) = ownerOf message state ∨ (addrArg1 message) = ownerOf message state)) ∧
      (pairOf message state ≠ 0 → limitedOf message state ≠ 0 → pairOf message state = (sender message) → (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat ≤ (maxHolding message state).toNat ∧ (minHolding message state).toNat ≤ (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat) ∧
      ((arg2 message).toNat ≤ (balance message state (sender message)).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ (sender message) → (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat < 2 ^ 256)) ∧
    ((s.output = wordBytes 1) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ (sender message) → (balance message s.state (sender message)).toNat = (balance message state (sender message)).toNat - (arg2 message).toNat ∧ (balance message s.state (addrArg1 message)).toNat = (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) = (sender message) → balance message s.state (sender message) = balance message state (sender message)) ∧
      (totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot (sender message) 1 → k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg1 message) 1 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      (s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget TRANSFER (sender message) (addrArg1 message) (wordBytes (arg2 message)))))

part_a.finding: When the pair is set, limited is on and minHoldingAmount > maxHoldingAmount, no transfer from the pair can succeed; and while the pair is blacklisted no transfer to or from it can succeed (per call; both follow directly from the requirements of the theorem).
part_a.statement:
theorem transfer_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0xa9059cbb)
    (hsep : Sep (callKeys message))
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (4 + 64 ≤ message.data.size) ∧
      (arg1 message = (addrArg1 message)) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      ((sender message) ≠ 0) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (addrArg1 message) = 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (sender message) = 0) ∧

part_a.statement:
theorem transfer_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0xa9059cbb)
    (hsep : Sep (callKeys message))
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (4 + 64 ≤ message.data.size) ∧
      (arg1 message = (addrArg1 message)) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      (pausedOf message state = 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (sender message) = 0) ∧
      (blacklisted message state (addrArg1 message) = 0) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ 0) ∧
      ((arg2 message).toNat ≤ (balance message state (sender message)).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ (sender message) → (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat < 2 ^ 256)) ∧
    ((s.output = wordBytes 1) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ (sender message) → (balance message s.state (sender message)).toNat = (balance message state (sender message)).toNat - (arg2 message).toNat ∧ (balance message s.state (addrArg1 message)).toNat = (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) = (sender message) → balance message s.state (sender message) = balance message state (sender message)) ∧
      (totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot (sender message) 3 → k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg1 message) 3 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      (s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget TRANSFER (sender message) (addrArg1 message) (wordBytes (arg2 message)))))

    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (4 + 96 ≤ message.data.size) ∧
      (arg1 message = (addrArg1 message)) ∧
      (arg2 message = (addrArg2 message)) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧

part_a.finding: Under the unproved keccak hypothesis Sep, a transfer(to, value) call that ends with no error needs to != 0 (masked), the token not paused and value <= the caller's balance; it moves value from the caller to to and adds one Transfer log.
part_a.statement:
theorem transfer_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0xa9059cbb)
    (hsep : Sep (callKeys message))
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      (pausedOf message state = 0) ∧
      ((arg2 message).toNat ≤ (balance message state (sender message)).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ 0) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ (sender message) → (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat < 2 ^ 256)) ∧
    ((s.output = wordBytes 1) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) ≠ (sender message) → (balance message s.state (sender message)).toNat = (balance message state (sender message)).toNat - (arg2 message).toNat ∧ (balance message s.state (addrArg1 message)).toNat = (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat + (arg2 message).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg1 message) = (sender message) → balance message s.state (sender message) = balance message state (sender message)) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot (sender message) 0 → k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg1 message) 0 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      (s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (Readable.log3 message.currentTarget TRANSFER (sender message) (addrArg1 message) (wordBytes (arg2 message)))))

part_a.finding: Under the unproved keccak hypothesis Sep, a transferFrom(from, to, value) call that ends with no error needs to != 0 and value <= allowance; it lowers allowed[from][spender] by value whatever its old value (2^256 - 1 included) and adds exactly one log, Transfer(from, to, value), with no Approval log.
part_a.statement:
theorem transferFrom_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0x23b872dd)
    (hsep : Sep (callKeys message))
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      (pausedOf message state = 0) ∧
      ((arg3 message).toNat ≤ (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat) ∧
      ((arg3 message).toNat ≤ (allowance message state (addrArg1 message) (sender message)).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) ≠ 0) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) ≠ (addrArg1 message) → (balance message state (addrArg2 message)).toNat + (arg3 message).toNat < 2 ^ 256)) ∧
    ((s.output = wordBytes 1) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) ≠ (addrArg1 message) → (balance message s.state (addrArg1 message)).toNat = (balance message state (addrArg1 message)).toNat - (arg3 message).toNat ∧ (balance message s.state (addrArg2 message)).toNat = (balance message state (addrArg2 message)).toNat + (arg3 message).toNat) ∧
      ((addrArg2 message) = (addrArg1 message) → balance message s.state (addrArg1 message) = balance message state (addrArg1 message)) ∧
      ((allowance message s.state (addrArg1 message) (sender message)).toNat = (allowance message state (addrArg1 message) (sender message)).toNat - (arg3 message).toNat) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg1 message) 0 → k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg2 message) 0 → k ≠ mapSlot (sender message) (mapSlot (addrArg1 message) 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      (s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (Readable.log3 message.currentTarget TRANSFER (addrArg1 message) (addrArg2 message) (wordBytes (arg3 message)))))

part_a.finding: An approve(spender, value) call that ends with no error sets allowed[caller][spender] to value whatever the old allowance was; its proved success conditions (value 0, not static, account exists, not paused) put no condition on the old allowance or on spender.
part_a.statement:
theorem approve_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0x095ea7b3)
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      (pausedOf message state = 0)) ∧
    ((s.output = wordBytes 1) ∧
      (allowance message s.state (sender message) (addrArg1 message) = (arg2 message)) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg1 message) (mapSlot (sender message) 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      (s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (Readable.log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL (sender message) (addrArg1 message) (wordBytes (arg2 message)))))

part_a.finding: A decreaseApproval(spender, subtracted) call that ends with no error sets the allowance to 0 when subtracted >= the old allowance, else to the old allowance minus subtracted, and logs Approval with the new value.
part_a.statement:
theorem decreaseApproval_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256)
    (hsel : selector message.data = 0x66188463)
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    ((message.value = 0) ∧
      (message.isStatic = false) ∧
      (hasAccount state message.currentTarget) ∧
      (pausedOf message state = 0)) ∧
    ((s.output = wordBytes 1) ∧
      ((allowance message state (sender message) (addrArg1 message)).toNat ≤ (arg2 message).toNat → allowance message s.state (sender message) (addrArg1 message) = 0) ∧
      ((arg2 message).toNat < (allowance message state (sender message) (addrArg1 message)).toNat → (allowance message s.state (sender message) (addrArg1 message)).toNat = (allowance message state (sender message) (addrArg1 message)).toNat - (arg2 message).toNat) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot (addrArg1 message) (mapSlot (sender message) 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k) ∧
      ((allowance message state (sender message) (addrArg1 message)).toNat ≤ (arg2 message).toNat → s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (Readable.log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL (sender message) (addrArg1 message) (wordBytes (0 : U256)))) ∧
      ((arg2 message).toNat < (allowance message state (sender message) (addrArg1 message)).toNat → s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (Readable.log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL (sender message) (addrArg1 message) (wordBytes (sub (allowance message state (sender message) (addrArg1 message)) (arg2 message))))))

part_a.finding: A reclaimToken run can end with no error only if the second call (transfer) returned at least 32 bytes with a first word that is not 0.
part_a.statement:
theorem reclaimToken_readable (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork) (hglam : fork < .glamsterdam)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256) (hsel : selector message.data = 0x17ffc320)
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (hrun : EndsL runChild evm s) (hok : s.error = none) :
    message.value = 0 ∧
    message.caller =
      toAddressMasked (div (storageAt state message.currentTarget (5 : U256)) (256 : U256)) ∧
    ∃ (caller1 : Evm fork Nat) (msg1 : Message fork) (child1 : Evm fork Nat)
      (caller2 : Evm fork Nat) (msg2 : Message fork) (child2 : Evm fork Nat),
      msg1.currentTarget = rcToken message ∧ msg1.caller = message.currentTarget ∧
      msg1.value = 0 ∧ msg1.data.size = 36 ∧ selector msg1.data = 0x70a08231 ∧
      loadWord msg1.data 4 32 = message.currentTarget.toU256 ∧
      ReadsAs caller1.state state ∧ caller1.substate.logs = substate.logs ∧
      Ran runChild caller1 msg1 child1 ∧ child1.error = none ∧ 32 ≤ child1.output.size ∧
      msg2.currentTarget = rcToken message ∧ msg2.caller = message.currentTarget ∧
      msg2.value = 0 ∧ msg2.data.size = 68 ∧ selector msg2.data = 0xa9059cbb ∧
      toAddressMasked (loadWord msg2.data 4 32) =
        toAddressMasked
          (div (storageAt child1.state message.currentTarget (5 : U256)) (256 : U256)) ∧
      loadWord msg2.data 36 32 = loadWord (memoryReadBytes child1.output 0 32) 0 32 ∧
      ReadsAs caller2.state child1.state ∧
      caller2.substate.logs = (incorporateChild fork caller1 child1).substate.logs ∧
      Ran runChild caller2 msg2 child2 ∧ child2.error = none ∧ 32 ≤ child2.output.size ∧
      loadWord (memoryReadBytes child2.output 0 32) 0 32 ≠ 0 ∧
      s.state = child2.state ∧ s.substate = (incorporateChild fork caller2 child2).substate ∧
      s.output = ByteArray.empty

theorem reclaimToken_falseReturn_reverts (hparis : .paris ≤ fork) (hglam : fork < .glamsterdam)

    (hcode : S.getCode (S.getAccount TOKEN).codeHash = .ok ZERO_CODE)
    {G : Nat} (hG : 2000000 ≤ G) (hG64 : G < 2 ^ 64) :
    RunsRevert fork (rcMsg b t C Witness.CALLER1 0x1000 G) S ss ByteArray.empty

part_a.finding: Witness: reclaimToken(WBTC) from the owner with WBTC holding 7 and the owner 5 runs with no error via two real nested self calls; WBTC's balance ends 0 and the owner's 12 (sum of the two unchanged) and every other storage word of WBTC, totalSupply_ included, is unchanged.
part_a.statement:
theorem reclaimToken_self_runs (hparis : .paris ≤ fork) (hglam : fork < .glamsterdam)
    (b : BlockEnvironment fork) (t : TransactionEnvironment fork) (ss : Substate)
    {C : Address} (hC : C.toU256 = WBTCW) {S : State.TransactionState}
    (hacc : hasAccount S C) (hcode : S.getCode (S.getAccount C).codeHash = .ok CODE)
    (h5 : storageAt S C (5 : U256) = OWNER_SLOT)
    (hbC : storageAt S C (mapSlot WBTCW (0 : U256)) = 7)
    (hbO : storageAt S C (mapSlot Witness.CALLER1W (0 : U256)) = 5)
    {G : Nat} (hG : 16000000 ≤ G) (hG64 : G < 2 ^ 64) :
    ∃ r, processMessage (Meter := Nat) fork (rcMsg b t C Witness.CALLER1 WBTCW G) S ss = .ok r ∧
      r.1.error = none ∧ r.1.output = ByteArray.empty ∧
      storageAt r.1.state C (mapSlot WBTCW (0 : U256)) = 0 ∧
      storageAt r.1.state C (mapSlot Witness.CALLER1W (0 : U256)) = 12 ∧
      (∀ n : U256, n ≠ mapSlot WBTCW (0 : U256) → n ≠ mapSlot Witness.CALLER1W (0 : U256) →
        storageAt r.1.state C n = storageAt S C n) ∧
      r.1.substate.logs = ss.logs ++
        #[Readable.log3 C TRANSFER_TOPIC WBTCW Witness.CALLER1W (wordBytes 7)]

part_a.finding: In every reclaimToken run that ends with no error, each CALL asks for all the gas left and the message gets the subCall part of messageCallGas (all but one 64th of what is left after the call cost).
part_a.statement:
theorem ok_reclaim (hfork : .berlin ≤ fork) (hglam : fork < .glamsterdam)
    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256) (hsel : selector message.data = 0x17ffc320)
    {gas : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}

    (hsize' : message.data.size < 2 ^ 256) (hsel : selector message.data = 0xc3cda520)
    (hdel : ∀ c, state.getCode (state.getAccount (toAddressMasked 1)).codeHash = .ok c →
      .pectra ≤ fork → delegatedAddress c = none)
    {gas bound : Nat} {evm s : Evm fork Nat}
    (start : At CODE message 0 [] .empty gas state substate evm)
    (within : GasMeter.gasHeld evm.gas ≤ bound)
    (hrun : Evm.runFrame (step fork) (step_decreases fork) bound (processRunner fork bound) evm
      within = .ok s)
    (hok : s.error = none) :
    sigSigner message ≠ 0 ∧
    (loadWord message.data 36 32) = storageAt state message.currentTarget (mapSlot (sigSigner message) 10) ∧
    message.blockEnv.timestamp.toNat ≤ (loadWord message.data 68 32).toNat

part_b.gap: The withdrawEther supply theorem rested on hrunner, a runner hypothesis machine-checked false for EthLib's real runner, so BNB had no real coverage of withdrawEther.
part_b.evidence: hrunner removed (kit-status.json fix_round.1). Replaced by local KeepsInv, proved for the real runner: Withdraw.processRunner_keepsInv in token-kit/tokens/bnb/BnbVerify/Bnb/Sanity/Withdraw.lean (Axioms yes); supply_withdrawEther restated in Bnb/Withdraw.lean (Axioms yes). Transaction level with no runner assumption via the stipend theorem: supply_any_transactions in Bnb/Tx.lean (Axioms yes, audits/bnb/fixes.json).

part_b.gap: The supply sequence theorem left out withdrawEther (14 of 15 functions) and assumed every non top-level step leaves the token storage alone.
part_b.evidence: Not named by ID in audits/bnb/fixes.json; acted on by fix 1 and fix 6. Calls.withdraw constructor and process_step_all in token-kit/tokens/bnb/BnbVerify/Bnb/Seq.lean (process_step_all Axioms yes); Untouched step replaced at transaction level by supply_any_transactions in Bnb/Tx.lean (Axioms yes), withdrawEther included.

part_b.gap: withdrawEther needed 8 side hypotheses plus the false hrunner, had no witness of a full successful run, and amount 0 was not covered.
part_b.evidence: Full real-runner witness withdrawEther_pays_closed (amount 1) in token-kit/tokens/bnb/BnbVerify/Bnb/Sanity/Withdraw.lean (Axioms yes); amount 0 covered by generality. Remains (kit-status.json fix_round.1 amount_0_and_failure_cases, hypotheses_now_assumed): no closed witness with amount 0; hdel (owner is no EIP-7702 delegation from Prague) and fork < Glamsterdam stay assumed.

part_b.gap: Withdraw reentrancy safety for a callee with code was assumed (CalleeKeeps restated the conclusion), so withdraws to contracts were not really covered.
part_b.evidence: CalleeKeeps retired (token-kit/tokens/weth/fix-status.json fix_3a, fix_3b). Stipend.processMessage_quiet in token-kit/TokenKit/Evm/Stipend.lean (in weth Axioms yes); calleeQuiet_process and solvent_preserved_process in token-kit/tokens/weth/WethVerify/Weth/Reenter.lean (Axioms yes): any callee code, no callee assumption.

part_b.gap: withdraw needed WithdrawReady (gas, depth, caller code readable, no EIP-7702 delegation, fork < Glamsterdam); failing runs were not proved and delegated callers were left out.
part_b.evidence: Paths.ok_withdraw_all and the withdraw_fails_* theorems in token-kit/tokens/weth/WethVerify/Weth/WithdrawAll.lean (ok_withdraw_all Axioms yes); real-runner witness Sanity.withdraw_runs_closed in Weth/Sanity/Withdraw.lean (Axioms yes). Remains: withdraw from an EIP-7702 delegated caller (from Prague) is excluded, not proved (weth/status.json not_covered; fix-status.json hypotheses_still_assumed del), plus fork < Glamsterdam.

part_b.gap: The sequence theorem covered only direct top-level messages; every other step (calls from other contracts, whole transactions) was the assumed Untouched step.
part_b.evidence: supply_any_transactions (over EthLib processTransaction, no Untouched step) in token-kit/tokens/dai/DaiVerify/Dai/Tx.lean (Axioms yes); audits/dai/fixes.json DAI-1 done. Still run-local Sep (keccak) assumed and block-level steps not covered.

part_b.gap: The sequence theorem covered only direct top-level messages; every other step was the assumed Untouched step, and Inv was never established.
part_b.evidence: supply_any_transactions and supply_from_zero in token-kit/tokens/usdd/UsddVerify/Usdd/Tx.lean (supply_any_transactions Axioms yes); audits/usdd/fixes.json USDD-1 done. Still run-local Sep assumed; block-level steps not covered.

part_b.gap: The sequence theorem covered only direct calls to UNI; transactions that call UNI from another contract were the assumed Untouched step, not listed in assumptions.
part_b.evidence: supply_any_transactions in token-kit/tokens/uni/UniVerify/Uni/Tx.lean (Axioms yes); audits/uni/fixes.json UNI-1 done. Sep keeps its non-finite group (every address word), named in assumptions.

part_b.gap: total supply never grows was proved only along direct top-level calls plus assumed Untouched steps, not for calls from inside other contracts or rollbacks.
part_b.evidence: supply_never_grows_any_transactions and supply_any_transactions in token-kit/tokens/wbt/WbtVerify/Wbt/Tx.lean (both Axioms yes); audits/wbt/fixes.json WBT-1 done. Block-level steps, constructor and forks before Dencun not covered.

part_b.gap: LINK's reentrancy and sequence headlines assumed global keccak hypotheses (SepAll, NoCollision CODE) that are almost certainly false, so they were likely vacuous.
part_b.evidence: Headlines restated on run-local keccak conditions: supply_all_real_local in token-kit/tokens/link/LinkVerify/Link/AnyLocal.lean (Axioms yes), inv_runL in Link/SeqLocal.lean (Axioms yes); global forms renamed (e.g. supply_all_real_sepAll_noCollision, Link/Any.lean, Axioms yes) and marked not usable in status.json. Closed instance with a re-entering receiver: Sanity.reenter_closed in Link/ReWit/Closed.lean (Axioms yes), under Sep RE_KEYS, hH, hRE (audits/link/fixes.json).

part_b.gap: The sequence model had no step for contract creation transactions, so any history with a deployment was outside the theorem; other non-message steps were assumed.
part_b.evidence: Creation step added: create_good_local and RunL.create in token-kit/tokens/link/LinkVerify/Link/SeqLocal.lean (create_good_local Axioms yes); audits/link/fixes.json LINK-2 done. Remains: LINK has no Tx.lean; fees, refunds, EIP-7702 authorizations, creation at L and whole transactions stay the assumed Other step (link/status.json not_covered; link-wbtc.json left).

part_b.gap: On the ERC-1271 permit branch the statement did not say the owner was called or answered the magic value (out was a free existential).
part_b.evidence: PermitByContract now carries OwnerCall (out = output of the real STATICCALL to the owner): staticcall_sent and ownerCall_of_sends in token-kit/tokens/sky/SkyVerify/Sky/OwnerCall.lean (Axioms yes); permit_contract_A and ok_permit_full in Sky/Permit1271.lean (Axioms yes); audits/sky/fixes.json SKY-1 done.

part_b.gap: permit(bytes) was proved only for a 65-byte signature; the contract-wallet route with other lengths was not covered by the supply or sequence theorems.
part_b.evidence: ok_permitBytes_full (no length hypothesis) and ok_permitBytes_other in token-kit/tokens/sky/SkyVerify/Sky/PermitBytesAny.lean, permit_contract_any in Sky/BytesCall.lean, supply_permitBytes (hlen gone) in Sky/PermitBytesSeq.lean, all Axioms yes; sequence via supply_any_transactions in Sky/Tx.lean (Axioms yes). audits/sky/fixes.json done. Left: gas after the STATICCALL is an inequality; no successful-run witness for permit(bytes).

part_b.gap: Same as UNI-1: the sequence theorem covered only direct calls to ONDO; calls from other contracts were the assumed Untouched step, and ONDO had no Tx.lean.
part_b.evidence: supply_any_transactions in token-kit/tokens/ondo/OndoVerify/Ondo/Tx.lean (Axioms yes); audits/ondo/fixes.json ONDO-1 done. Block-level steps and the constructor not covered.
